alignments.note: Rule 66: the ASV renders the verb by the nominal frame it was the good pleasure, headed on pleasure, which glosses the eudok- lexeme; the supplied subject and copula ride along under rules 7 and 9.

Rule 5: the ASV supplies of the Father, italicized, and no source token in this verse licenses it. The Greek leaves the subject of eudokesen unexpressed and the marginal alternative shows the ASV knew the other construal; nothing here answers to these three words.

Rule 85: the supplied complementizer that belongs to the non-finite complement the ASV expands into a finite clause, not to the governing finite verb; should is the expansion's modal, the unit discontinuous under rule 15.

review_notes: of the Father is added under rule 5: no source token licenses it, and rule 7 cannot fold a full lexical noun phrase onto a neighbouring token.
that (t010) goes to the infinitive under rule 85 rather than to eudokesen; rule 74's aside is scoped to a supplied subject and does not decide a complementizer's placement.
